name: HT04f. HIV Negative Referred to Prevention (SNS)
description: Number of HIV negative social network strategy contacts referred to HIV prevention services during period
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hts_contact_tracing a
JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
  ON mdp.client_id = a.client_id
WHERE
  a.encounter_date >= :startDate
  AND a.encounter_date < :endDate
  AND mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
  AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
  AND a.hiv_test_results = 'Negative'
  AND a.hiv_prevention_services IS NOT NULL
;
